name: Dispelling Evil
label: Quest
description: Dispelling Evil: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, adventurer. Crusaders like you are a welcome sight in these desolate reaches.

Your holy strength is needed to help fight the endless undead here. We need you to collect a large number of scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis. The high priest can be found guarding Uther's Tomb in Sorrow Hill, not far from here.
Only one with an Argent Dawn Commission can hope to find scourgestones, so speak to Officer Pureheart if you haven't already.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What evil have you brought me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: There is risk in dispelling the evil from a scourgestone, for it attracts the attention of undead for countless miles. But you are strong in the Light, friend, and I do not fear for you...
